contract_term.quote: The agreement resulting from this RFP shall be in effect from the date of official acceptance by the County until December 31, 2025, subject to the following: (a) When mutually agreeable between the County and the successful proponent, this agreement may be renewed under the same terms and conditions for a period of up to one (1) additional year and said option to renew this agreement for an additional one (1) year period, shall be in effect for each year thereafter for a total period not to exceed three (3) years.

scope_of_deliverables.value: Rocky View County is seeking a proponent to conduct an ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review. The work is described in Section A of Appendix D (starting on page 20, per Table of Contents on page 2) and includes analyzing current systems, identifying requirements for a new ERP system, and assessing the County's readiness for implementation. The RFP requires proponents to provide a work plan, methodology, quality assurance processes, and a person-hour schedule for each project phase (page 34).
scope_of_deliverables.quote: This Request for Proposals (the “RFP”) is an invitation by Rocky View County (the “County”) to qualified prospective proponents to submit proposals for the County's ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, as further described in Section A of Appendix D of this RFP.

pricing_structure.value: Pricing is evaluated on a scale of 0 to 5 and carries a weighting of 25% of the total RFP score. The pricing evaluation is based on the unit rate and total cost basis, using the formula: {(Submitted cost / Lowest cost) * Weight i.e. 25%}. The pricing submission must be in the form of a TASK-FEE SCHEDULE (Unit price and Lump-sum price structure) and must be submitted as a separate digital file, not included in the technical proposal. The pricing schedule must be completed as set out in Section F of Appendix D, and the pricing instructions are in Appendix C.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: Vendor Shortlisting and Demonstration Preparation: The RFP Evaluation Committee will select the Vendors that will be shortlisted to provide a product demonstration and assist the County in clarifying any outstanding queries with shortlisted Vendors prior to the product demonstration process.

vendor_experience_required.value: The Project Manager must have a minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period. Project team members must have a minimum of three (3) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period. Preference will be given to Project Managers with professional project management certification(s) from recognized, accredited 3rd party organizations (i.e. the Project Management Institute (PMI)) or post-secondary academic institutions. Proponents shall provide a comprehensive list of key personnel, including subject-matters specialists in areas such as Change Management, Data Migration, and Systems Integration, and Sub-Consultants (if any), with descriptions of roles and an organizational chart. Proponents shall also include an applicable project listing and professional résumé for each project team member, clearly outlining their post-secondary education, years of work experience, technical certifications, and roles/responsibilities on similar projects. Additionally, proponents must provide a minimum of three (3) client references for similar/identical services within the last seven (7) years, preferably from the public sector, with detailed information including client name, contact info, contract value, duration, project scope, and key team members.
vendor_experience_required.quote:
The Proponent's appointed Project Manager (and back-up Project Manager) shall have a minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period. Preference will be given to Project Managers with professional project management certification(s) from recognized, accredited 3rd party organizations (i.e. the Project Management Institute (PMI)) or post-secondary academic institutions.

(b) Project team members must have a minimum of three (3) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period.

(c) Proponents shall provide a comprehensive list of the key personnel (which may include but not be limited to subject-matters specialists in such areas as Change Management, Data Migration, and Systems Integration), and Sub-Consultants (if any) that will be assigned to the project described herein, and include a description of each person's role in the project, as well as an organizational chart which identifies the reporting structure between the Proponent's project team, and the key stakeholders that will be involved in the project.

(d) Proponents shall also include an applicable project listing and professional résumé for each project team member which clearly outlines their post-secondary education, years of work experience, technical certifications, and roles/responsibilities on projects that are similar or identical to the services described herein.

value: Security measures and compliance requirements for cloud data storage and transmission must be evaluated as part of the Cloud Readiness Assessment. The deliverable 'Security Protocols' requires defining security protocols and measures necessary to safeguard sensitive information stored within the ERP system, including role-based access controls, data encryption, audit trails, and compliance with data protection regulations.
